text: {"table": {"name": "results", "purpose": "Formula 1 race results: one row per driver per race, with grid position, finishing position, points, laps completed, finishing time/gap, fastest-lap data and finishing status. This is the standard Ergast F1 database 'results' table."}, "columns": {"col_001": {"role": "identifier", "name": "resultId", "description": "Primary key of the results table; unique surrogate id for one driver's result in one race.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_002": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "raceId", "description": "Reference to races table; identifies which race this result belongs to.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_003": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "driverId", "description": "Reference to drivers table; identifies the driver of this result.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_004": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "constructorId", "description": "Reference to constructors table; identifies the team the driver raced for in this race.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_005": {"role": "code", "name": "number", "description": "Driver's car number for the race (0-208, mostly small numbers; 0 used when no number).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_006": {"role": "code", "name": "grid", "description": "Starting grid position (0 = started from pit lane, values up to 34).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_007": {"role": "code", "name": "position", "description": "Official finishing position as a number; null (~44.5%) when the driver did not finish (retired/did not classify).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_008": {"role": "code", "name": "positionText", "description": "Finishing position as text: numeric string for classified finishers, 'R' for retired, 'F' and similar codes for other non-finishes (e.g. disqualified/excluded).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_009": {"role": "code", "name": "positionOrder", "description": "Finishing position as a dense ordinal (1..39) with all finishers ordered, used for ranking including non-classified drivers.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_010": {"role": "numeric", "name": "points", "description": "Championship points scored in this race (0-50; 0 for most rows, 25 for a win, half points and sprint values appear).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_011": {"role": "numeric", "name": "laps", "description": "Number of laps completed by the driver in this race (0-200).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_012": {"role": "numeric", "name": "time", "description": "Finishing time or gap to the winner as text, e.g. '+24.160' or '+8:22.19'; null for winner and non-finishers.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_013": {"role": "numeric", "name": "milliseconds", "description": "Finishing time in milliseconds (1.47M-15.09M ms ≈ 25 min - 4.2 h); null for non-finishers.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_014": {"role": "numeric", "name": "fastestLap", "description": "Lap number on which the driver set their fastest lap (2-78); null for most rows (recorded only in recent seasons).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_015": {"role": "code", "name": "rank", "description": "Rank of the driver's fastest lap within the race (0-24, 0 = no valid fastest lap); null where fastest-lap data is absent.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_016": {"role": "numeric", "name": "fastestLapTime", "description": "Fastest lap time as text in m:ss.mmm format, e.g. '1:34.091'; null where not recorded.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_017": {"role": "numeric", "name": "fastestLapSpeed", "description": "Average speed of the fastest lap in km/h (89.5-257.3); null where not recorded.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_018": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "statusId", "description": "Reference to the status lookup table; code for how the driver's race ended (1 = finished, 11 = retired, etc.).", "status": "resolved"}}}
